comment: Round 177 Direction 2: Beacon Tower definitions. A Beacon is an ACTIVE 'command post' tower with NO auto-attack, NO projectile, and NO enemy targeting. Its only role is to broadcast BOTH a damage bonus and an attack-speed bonus to ALL friendly towers in radius. Distinct from Shrine (which has a single typed aura: gold/mana/dmg/atk-spd only) and from AuraTower (legacy SOACopy pattern with TowerAura* fields). Beacons stack additively across multiple instances. PlaceTower post-init defaults to a +10% damage/+10% atk-spd beacon (radius=3); this JSON documents the v1 template values designers can override.

beacons.name: Outpost Beacon
beacons.description: +10% damage and +10% attack speed on friendly towers in 3 cells

beacons.name: Battle Beacon
beacons.description: +18% damage and +12% attack speed on friendly towers in 2.5 cells

beacons.name: Command Beacon
beacons.description: +8% damage and +20% attack speed on friendly towers in 4 cells
